name: Brazier hall vault
notes: The wiring of the brazier hall (scene brazier-hall, mw-e15.3): the puzzle runtime switches the vault latch on when the puzzle brazier-hall is solved, and the latch raises the portcullis. Nothing in the hall pulls the lever by hand: the puzzle is the only thing that opens the vault, so every way of lighting the braziers opens it. Binding names are the scene's spawn ids.
